items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: When we got to Glasgow, true to his word, he was there at the station. He took me to the hotel

ctx.x: About a week prior to going to Scotland, I got this letter... No, it wasn't. I received this letter the first week I was in England from this guy in Scotland saying that he knew I was coming to Scotland, and he would be there to greet me when we got there. Now, this is like almost a month before we were to play Scotland. And I was just delighted to know that anybody outside of Washington, D.C., or the United States for sure, would know anything about me. Anyway, this fellow's name was John Scott Henderson, and he…

When we got to Glasgow, true to his word, he was there at the station. He took me to the hotel... First thing, he offered me a place to stay at his house, but I told him that reservations had already been made. So he took me to my hotel, took me around to the barber shop to get a haircut and whatever. He just stayed with me, and welcomed me to Scotland all the way.
